turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I see you are not eating, is it not good?

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Eat yourself, my love, you are too thin.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am not hungry, but I would see you eat.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, father, I will eat for you, please let me.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: No, my son, you will not eat for me, you must eat for yourself.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, stop talking, you are tired.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am not tired, I am just a little weak.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Mother, may I get you some tea?

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Yes, child, bring me some tea, but not too hot.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, we will talk about this later, just rest now.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I will rest when you are married and settled.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Father, I will find you a good wife, do not worry.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: You will do no such thing, you will follow your own path.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will find a good wife, do not worry, my love.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: You have always been a good husband to me.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Mother, your hair is falling out, may I brush it for you?

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Yes, child, I would like that.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You are still beautiful to me.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: You are kind to me, but I am old and ugly.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, you are not old and ugly, you are wise and kind.

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Well, and if I am ugly, [GE-OMITTED:50:aa] [GE-OMITTED:51:aa]
